Saturday, October 17, 2026

Our Annual Dinner,by the water.

An oyster roast and cocktails. Live music and a little magic. A beautiful dinner with the friends who make this club special.

Join us at a private waterfront home in Wilmington. Come with your spouse or on your own—and make an evening of it.

Much more than dinner

A few surprises.
A lot of good company.

Picture a drink in hand, the water just beyond the lawn, and plenty of time to catch up. There’s something happening throughout cocktail time—but no need to rush from one activity to the next.

A coastal welcome

Oyster roast & cocktails

Start the evening with an oyster roast during cocktail time. Enjoy oysters, light hors d’oeuvres, and a drink while visiting with friends beside the water. Not an oyster fan? Enjoy the other bites and the company.

Right before your eyes

Roaming magic with Neal Chamberlain

Neal brings close-up magic to small groups as guests mingle. You won’t need to gather for a stage show—the surprises come to you, with conversation, laughter, and a few “How did he do that?” moments along the way.

Meet Neal Chamberlain (opens new tab)

Remember your first set of wheels?

Match the first car to the member

Was he a Mustang man—or did he start out in a well-worn station wagon? Visit the “My First Car” display and try to match each car to the member who owned it. Expect some unexpected answers and stories worth retelling.

When registration opens September 17, tell us your first car’s make, model, and year so yours can be part of the guessing game.

Music by the water

A live band, an easygoing afternoon

Live music sets the mood for cocktails and carries the evening into dinner. Enjoy it from a comfortable seat, catch up with old friends, or get to know someone new—with the music kept at a level that welcomes conversation.

A little friendly competition

Try the putting challenge

Step up for a putt and see how you compare with your fellow members. It’s an easy way to join the fun, with a small prize and bragging rights on the line. Watching and cheering are welcome, too.

An evening to remember

Photos with friends & spouses

A photographer will capture the gathering, with a waterfront photo area for couples and friends. Take a moment for a photograph together, then return to the music, conversation, and festivities.

Everything is optional. Join a game, enjoy the magic, or simply relax with friends. This is your evening to enjoy at your own pace.

Around 6 PM

Pull up a chair.
Dinner is served.

As afternoon gives way to evening, we’ll gather for a seated dinner overlooking the water. The meal is served at the table, so you can settle in and enjoy your company without a buffet line.

Good food, quiet music, and time with friends—the kind of dinner that invites you to linger.

Registration & ticket details
  • Beef tenderloinThe centerpiece of our dinner menu.
  • Fish entréeAn alternative for guests who prefer fish.

Salad, sides, bread, dessert, and coffee round out the planned meal. Choose an entrée for each person when you RSVP.

An unhurried evening

Here’s how it unfolds.

  1. 4:00 PM

    Welcome & oyster roast

    Arrive, settle in with a drink, and enjoy oysters and hors d’oeuvres by the water.

  2. During cocktails

    Music, magic & memories

    Mingle, meet Neal, match first cars, try a putt, or take a photo with friends.

  3. 5:45–6:00 PM

    Gather for dinner

    A brief welcome, then take your place for our served waterfront dinner.

  4. 7:30 PM

    Until next time

    Finish dessert and conversation, then make your way home after an early evening together.

Comfort comes first

Come ready to relax.

Parking & getting around

Passenger drop-off at the home and golf-cart shuttles to and from nearby parking are planned. Seating will be available during the reception as well as dinner. Detailed parking directions will follow.

A comfortable place for you

The property includes lawn, terraces, and changes in level. For step-free routes, elevator access, restroom access, or mobility assistance, please contact the events team before booking so we can confirm arrangements for you.

Rain or shine—we’ll be together

Join us on Saturday, October 17, whatever the weather. If it rains, we’ll move the party inside the home. The date and time stay the same: 4–7:30 PM.

What to wear & who to ask

Think comfortable outdoor dinner attire: a collared shirt and slacks, or a casual dress or separates. Bring a layer for the breeze and shoes suitable for grass.

Questions, dietary requests, or help with arrangements? Email events@seniormensclub.org.
